result.markdown:
# Grand Tunis Traffic Surge due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct temporal and spatial correlation with a stadium event and high PRB warnings on the affected sites.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-12 18:45 to 2026-09-12 22:15
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-12 18:33
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

High traffic and active users in Grand Tunis were caused by an expected public event at the Rades Olympic complex.

Unusually high usage on three Grand Tunis sites (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003) between 18:45 and 22:15.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 18:33: Stadium event started at Rades Olympic complex near S-TUN-001. [EVT-001]
- 2026-09-12 18:45: Traffic and active users alert ALR-0015 raised for S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [ALR-0015]
- 2026-09-12 19:41: High PRB utilization warning raised on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000254]
- 2026-09-12 19:42: High PRB utilization warning raised on S-TUN-002. [ALM-000255]
- 2026-09-12 22:15: Traffic alert ALR-0015 ended. [ALR-0015]
- 2026-09-12 22:23: Stadium event ended at Rades Olympic complex. [EVT-001]
- 2026-09-12 22:44: High PRB warning cleared on S-TUN-002. [ALM-000255]
- 2026-09-12 22:49: High PRB warning cleared on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000254]

## Evidence

- Alert ALR-0015 showed active users and traffic drop/surge on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [ALR-0015]
- Stadium event EVT-001 occurred near S-TUN-001 from 18:33 to 22:23. [EVT-001]
- High PRB warnings matched the timing of the stadium event. [ALM-000254, ALM-000255, EVT-001]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected sites or parents during the window. [T7]
- Traffic spikes on S-TUN-003 reached 108642 MB volume and 719 active users. [ANM-000189, ANM-000190]

## Inferences

- High usage was an expected public event-driven surge rather than a failure. [EVT-001, ALR-0015]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. The timing of the traffic surge precisely matches the stadium event at Rades Olympic complex near the sites. [EVT-001, ALR-0015]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-A: rejected. Alarms cleared promptly and traffic patterns reflect high user volume rather than link loss. [ALM-000254, ALM-000255]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000256: Mains failure occurred on S-SAH-009 outside the affected Grand Tunis sites and scope.
- ALM-000257: Link degraded alarm on LNK-TUN-02-A raised near midnight after the incident window concluded.
- ALM-000253: VSWR high alarm on S-TUN-018 cleared quickly at 18:18 and did not impact the main traffic surge.
- ALR-0016: Alert covers a different group of sites (S-TUN-006, S-TUN-008, S-TUN-018) starting past midnight.

## Recommended actions

- No action needed as this was a temporary surge due to a public event.
- Monitor event schedules near urban sites to anticipate capacity bottlenecks.

- `ALR-0015`: ended alert from 2026-09-12 18:45: 3 site(s) (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003); core CORE-UPF-01; region-level TUN; metrics: active_users, dl_volume_mb, latency_ms, pr...
